metaData.originalTitle: Introducing computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash
metaData.title: Introducing computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Google announces that computer use is now a built-in capability in Gemini 3.5 Flash, enabling developers to build agents that interact with browser, mobile, and desktop environments.
metaData.summary: Google DeepMind announces that computer use, previously a separate model, is now natively integrated into Gemini 3.5 Flash. The built-in tool allows developers to create custom agents that can see, reason, and take actions across browser, mobile, and desktop environments. The post highlights improved performance for long-horizon and enterprise automation tasks such as continuous software testing and knowledge work. To address safety, the model uses targeted adversarial training and offers optional enterprise safeguards like requiring user confirmation for sensitive actions and automatic task stopping upon indirect prompt injection. The post includes customer testimonials from Browserbase and provides links to try the demo, reference implementation, and API documentation.

mainPoints.point: Computer use is now built into Gemini 3.5 Flash, replacing the standalone model.
mainPoints.explanation: Developers can access computer use directly via the Gemini API and Enterprise Agent Platform, simplifying development of agentic workflows.

mainPoints.point: The capability enables agents to see, reason, and act across browser, mobile, and desktop environments.
mainPoints.explanation: This opens up long-horizon automation tasks such as software testing and knowledge work in professional applications.

mainPoints.point: Safety measures include adversarial training and optional enterprise safeguards.
mainPoints.explanation: Enterprises can enforce user confirmation for irreversible actions and automatically halt tasks when indirect prompt injection is detected, with a defense-in-depth approach recommended.

relatedArticles.title: Best practices for computer and browser use with Claude | Claude
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides official best practices for integrating Claude's computer and browser use capabilities, focusing on screenshot scaling, resolution selection, click accuracy optimization, thinking effort tuning, and prompt injection defense.

relatedArticles.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DiffusionGemma is an experimental 26B MoE model from Google DeepMind that uses text diffusion to generate entire blocks of text in parallel, achieving up to 4x faster inference on local GPUs compared to traditional autoregressive models.

relatedArticles.title: Codex Now Integrates Directly with Chrome on macOS and Windows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces a new Chrome extension for Codex on macOS and Windows, enabling the AI to operate directly within a user's live browser session to perform complex, parallel automation tasks using their active profile and direct code execution.

relatedArticles.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: Enhanced Embodied Reasoning
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6, a significant upgrade to its embodied reasoning model that enhances spatial understanding, multi-view reasoning, and introduces new capabilities like instrument reading for real-world robotics applications.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.5, a new category of AI that acts as an autonomous agent capable of planning, reasoning, and executing complex multi-step tasks across different applications.

relatedArticles.title: A harness for every task: dynamic workflows in Claude Code  | Claude
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Claude Code's dynamic workflows let Claude write custom agentic harnesses on the fly, enabling it to tackle complex, multi-step tasks that a single context window cannot handle reliably.

relatedArticles.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5, a generally available Mythos-class model with state-of-the-art capabilities, alongside Claude Mythos 5 for trusted cybersecurity partners, with new safeguards to mitigate misuse risks.

relatedArticles.title: Gemma 4: Byte for byte, the most capable open models
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemma 4, a family of open models (2B to 31B) optimized for advanced reasoning, agentic workflows, and multimodal tasks under an Apache 2.0 license.

relatedArticles.title: Decoupled DiLoCo: Resilient， Distributed AI Training at Scale
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Google DeepMind introduces Decoupled DiLoCo, a distributed training architecture that decouples compute into resilient 'islands' to enable fault-tolerant, low-bandwidth, and hardware-heterogeneous LLM training at global scale.

relatedArticles.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: the next generation of expressive AI speech
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS, a new text-to-speech model offering enhanced expressivity, controllability via natural language audio tags, support for 70+ languages, and built-in SynthID watermarking for AI content detection.
